test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A student‘s marks were wrongly entered as 65 instead of 45. Due to this, the average marks for the class got increased by 1/3. The number of students in the class is:
solution:
**Given:**

** **Average with the marks were counted 45 = x

 Average when the marks were counted 65 = x+{1over3}

**Concept used:**

 x = x = {sum y over n}

Here n is the total number of students. 

Let the sum of marks of rest of the students sum z \: 

**Calculation:**

x = {sum z+45over n}

nx = sum z +45 {equation 1}

x + 1over3 = {sum z+65over n}

 nx + nover3 = +65

Putting the value of nx from equation 1

 sum z + 45 + nover3 = sum z + 65

 nover3 = 20

 n = 60

∴ **The number of students is** **60**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

A student‘s marks were wrongly entered as 65 instead of 45, so 20 marks extra were distributed among students.

Due to this, the average marks for the class got increased by 1/3, so the number of students in the class = 20 × 3 = 60
